name: Let's Get Bitter Together
source:
After years of living abroad, Eva Hoffendorf comes back to her hometown of Ivehorn. She reunites with her childhood friend, Lirion, in a café, and from this point on, they live happily ever after.

At least that was the plan.

People of Ivehorn become victims to a mysterious wave of sleepiness and only a select few seems to not be affected – Eva and Lirion included. As their first meeting in years progresses, they realize they're being observed by someone who just might hold the key to understanding all of this... and much, much more. 

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/lets-get-bitter-together]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在国外生活多年后，伊娃·霍芬多夫回到家乡艾维霍恩。她在咖啡馆与童年好友利里昂重逢，从此幸福地生活在一起。

至少，原本是这么打算的。

艾维霍恩的居民遭到一阵神秘睡意侵袭，似乎只有少数人不受影响，其中就包括伊娃与利里昂。多年后的第一次相聚仍在继续，两人却发现，有人正在观察他们。那个人或许掌握着理解这一切的关键…甚至，远不止如此。

[摘自[url=https://naarel.itch.io/lets-get-bitter-together]Itch.io[/url]]
